definitions.explanation: A classical dance form characterized by precise, formalized movements and elaborate costumes and staging, or a theatrical performance of such dancing.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{五歳|ごさい}からバレエを{習|なら}っている。
examples.english: My daughter has been taking ballet lessons since she was five.

examples.japanese: 「{白鳥|はくちょう}の{湖|みずうみ}」のバレエ{公演|こうえん}を{観|み}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to see a ballet performance of Swan Lake.

examples.japanese: バレエダンサーになるには{厳|きび}しい{訓練|くんれん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Rigorous training is required to become a ballet dancer.

notes:
SPELLING NOTE: バレエ is the standard spelling for ballet. バレー (with long ー) typically refers to volleyball ({バレーボール|ばれーぼーる}).

FAMOUS BALLETS:
・「{白鳥|はくちょう}の{湖|みずうみ}」(Swan Lake)
・「くるみ{割|わ}り{人形|にんぎょう}」(The Nutcracker)
・「{眠|ねむ}れる{森|もり}の{美女|びじょ}」(Sleeping Beauty)
・「ロメオとジュリエット」(Romeo and Juliet)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・バレエ{団|だん} (ballet company)
・バレエ{教室|きょうしつ} (ballet class/studio)
・バレエダンサー (ballet dancer)
・プリマバレリーナ (prima ballerina)
・トウシューズ (pointe shoes)
・チュチュ (tutu)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・バレエを{習|なら}う (to take ballet lessons)
・バレエを{踊|おど}る (to dance ballet)
・バレエ{公演|こうえん} (ballet performance)
